G3588.def:
**ὁ**, ἡ, τό,
_the prepositive article_ (ἄρθρον προτακτικόν), originally a demonstr. pron. (so usually in Hom.), in general corresponding to the Eng. definite article.
I. As demonstr. pron.
1. As frequently in Hom., absol., **he (she, it), his** (etc.): [[Act.17.28|Act.17:28]] (quoted from the poet Aratus).
2. Distributive, ὁ μὲν . . . ὁ δέ, **the one . . . the other**: [[1Co.7.7|1Co.7:7]], [[Gal.4.22|Gal.4:22]]; pl., [[Act.14.4; 17.32|Act.14:4, 17:32]], [[Php.1.16|Php.1:16]], al.; οἱ μὲν . . . ἄλλοι δέ, [[Mat.16.14|Mat.16:14]], [[Jhn.7.12|Jhn.7:12]]; οἱ μεν̀ . . . ὁδέ, [[Heb.7.21, 23|Heb.7:21, 23]].
3. In narration (without ὁ μὲν preceding), ὁ δέ, **but he**: [[Mat.2.14|Mat.2:14]], [[Mrk.1.45|Mrk.1:45]], [[Luk.8.21|Luk.8:21]], [[Jhn.9.38|Jhn.9:38]], al. mult.
II. As prepositive article, **the**, prefixed,
1. **to nouns unmodified**: ὁ θεός, τὸ φῶς, etc.; to abstract nouns, ἡ σοφία, etc., to pl. nouns which indicate a class, οἱ ἀλώπεκες, foxes, [[Mat.8.20|Mat.8:20]], al.; to an individual as representing a class, ὁ ἐργάτης, [[Luk.10.7|Luk.10:7]] with nom. = voc. in addresses, [[Mat.11.26|Mat.11:26]], [[Jhn.19.3|Jhn.19:3]], [[Jas.5.1|Jas.5:1]], al.; to things which pertain to one, ἡ χεῖρ, **his hand**, [[Mrk.3.1|Mrk.3:1]] to names of persons well known or already mentioned; usually to names of countries (originally adjectives), ἡ Ἰουδαία, etc.
2. **To modified nouns**: with of person(s) pron. genitive, μοῦ, σοῦ, etc.; with poss. pron., ἐμός, σός, etc.; with adj. between the art. and the noun, ὁ ἀγαθὸς ἄνθρωπος, [[Mat.12.35|Mat.12:35]] the noun foll, by adj., both with art., ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλός, [[Jhn.10.11|Jhn.10:11]] (on ὁ ὄχλος πολύς, [[Jhn.12.9|Jhn.12:9]], see M, _Pr._, 84); before adjectival phrases, ἡ κατ᾽ ἐκλογὴν πρόθεσις, [[Rom.9.11|Rom.9:11]]
3. To Other parts of speech used as substantives;
(a) **neuter adjectives**: τ. ἀγαθόν, etc.;
(b) **cardinal numerals**: ὁ εἶς, οἷ δύο, etc.;
(with) **participles**: ὁ βαπτίζων (= ὁ Βαπτιστής, [[Mat.14.2|Mat.14:2]]), [[Mrk.6.14|Mrk.6:14]]; πᾶς ὁ, with ptcp., **every one who**, etc.;
(d) **adverbs**: τὸ πέραν, τὰ νῦν, ὁ ἔσω ἄνθρωπος;
(e) **infinitives**: nom., τὸ θέλειν, [[Rom.7.18|Rom.7:18]], al.; genitive, τοῦ, after adjectives, ἄξιον τοῦ πορεύεσθαι, [[1Co.16.4|1Co.16:4]] verbs, ἐλαχεν τοῦ θυμιᾶσαι, [[Luk.1.9|Luk.1:9]] and frequently in a final sense, ἐξῆλθεν ὁ σπείρειν, [[Mat.13.3|Mat.13:3]] (on the artic. inf., see Bl., §71).
4. In the neut. to sentences, **phrases or single words treated as a quotation**: τὸ Ἐι δύνῃ, [[Mrk.9.23|Mrk.9:23]] τὸ ἔτι ἅπαξ, [[Heb.12.27|Heb.12:27]] τὸ ἀνέβη, [[Eph.4.9|Eph.4:9]], al.
5. **To prepositional phrases**: οἱ ἀπὸ Ἰταλίας, [[Heb.13.24|Heb.13:24]] οἱ ἐκ νόμου, [[Rom.4.14|Rom.4:14]] neut. accusative absol., in adverbial phrases, τὸ καθ᾽ ἡμέραν, **daily**, [[Luk.11.3|Luk.11:3]] τὸ κατὰ σάρκα, **as regards the flesh**, [[Rom.9.5|Rom.9:5]]
6. To nouns in the genitive, denoting kinship, association, etc.: ὁ τοῦ, **the son of** (unless context indicates a different relationship), [[Mat.10.2|Mat.10:2]], al.; τὰ τοῦ θεοῦ, **the things that pertain to God**, [[Mat.16.23|Mat.16:23]] τὰ τῆς εἰρήνης, [[Rom.14.19|Rom.14:19]] (cf. M, _Pr._, 81ff.; Bl, §§46, 47).
(AS)

G3598.def:
**ὁδός**, -οῦ, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly (very freq.) for דֶּרֶךְ ;]
1. **a way, path, road**: [[Mat.2.12|Mat.2:12]], [[Mrk.10.46|Mrk.10:46]], [[Luk.3.5|Luk.3:5]] al.; κατὰ τὴν ὁ., [[Luk.10.4|Luk.10:4]], al.; παρὰ τὴν ὁ., [[Mat.13.4|Mat.13:4]], al.; with genitive of person(s), (subj.), τὴν ὁ. ἑτοιμάζειν (fig.), [[Mat.3.3|Mat.3:3]], [[Mrk.1.3|Mrk.1:3]], al.; with genitive term. (obj.), ἐθνῶν, [[Mat.10.5|Mat.10:5]] τ. ἁγίων (figuratively), [[Heb.9.8|Heb.9:8]] accusative, ὁδόν, with force of prep. (like Heb. דֶּרֶךְ; Bl., §34, 8; 35, 5), ὁ. θαλάσσης, [[Mat.4.15|Mat.4:15]] (LXX).
2. A traveller's **way, journey**: ἐν τ. ὁ., [[Mat.5.25|Mat.5:25]], [[Mrk.8.27|Mrk.8:27]], al.; ἐξ ὁ., [[Luk.11.6|Luk.11:6]] εἰς ὁ., [[Mat.10.10|Mat.10:10]] τ. ὁδὸν πορεύεσθαι, [[Act.8.39|Act.8:39]] ὁ. ἡμέρας, [[Luk.2.44|Luk.2:44]] ὁδὸν ποιεῖν (= cl., ὁ. ποιεῖσθαι; V. Field, _Notes_, 25), **to make** one's **way**, i.e. proceed on one's journey, [[Mrk.2.23|Mrk.2:23]]
3. Metaphorical (cl.; but esp. frequently in Heb.; see Cremer, 442ff.), of a course of conduct, a way of thinking or acting: [[Act.14.16|Act.14:16]], [[1Co.4.17; 12.31|1Co.4:17 12:31]], [[Jas.1.8; 5.20|Jas.1:8 5:20]]; τοῦ Κάϊν, [[Jude.11|Ju 11]]; τ. Βαλαάμ, [[2Pe.2.15|2Pe.2:15]] εἰρήνης, [[Rom.3.17|Rom.3:17]] ζωῆς, [[Act.2.28|Act.2:28]] ἡ ὁ. ἡ ἀπάγουσα εἰς τ. ζωήν (Dalman, _Words_, 160), [[Mat.7.14|Mat.7:14]] τ. δικαιοσύνης, [[Mat.21.32|Mat.21:32]] σωτηρίας, [[Act.16.17|Act.16:17]] αἱ ὁ. τ. θεοῦ (κυρίου), [[Act.13.10|Act.13:10]], [[Rom.11.33|Rom.11:33]], [[Rev.15.3|Rev.15:3]] (cf. [[Hos.14.9|Hos.14:9]] Psa.94 (95):10, [[Sir.39.24|Sir.39:24]], al.); ἡ ὁ. τ. θεοῦ (the way approved by God), [[Mat.22.16|Mat.22:16]], [[Mrk.12.14|Mrk.12:14]], [[Luk.20.21|Luk.20:21]]; id., of the Christian religion, [[Act.18.26|Act.18:26]] so, absol., ἡ ὁ., [[Act.9.2; 19.9, 23; 24.22|Act.9:2 19:9, 23 24:22]]; of Christ as the means of approach to God, [[Jhn.14.6|Jhn.14:6]]
4. Ellipsis of ὁ.: ποίας (sc. ὁδοῦ), [[Luk.5.19|Luk.5:19]] ἐκείνης, [[Luk.19.4|ib. 19:4]] (see Bl., §36, 13; 44, 1).
(AS)

G3571.def:
**νύξ ** genitive νυκτός, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for לַיִל ;]
**night**: [[Mat.12.40|Mat.12:40]], [[Mrk.6.48|Mrk.6:48]], [[Jhn.13.30|Jhn.13:30]], al.; genitive temp. (of the time within which something happens; M, _Pr._, 73; B1., § 36, 13), νυκτός, by night, [[Mat.2.14|Mat.2:14]], [[Jhn.3.2|Jhn.3:2]], [[1Th.5.7|1Th.5:7]], al.; ν. κ. ἡμέρας, [[Mrk.5.5|Mrk.5:5]], [[1Th.2.9|1Th.2:9]], al.; ἡμέρας κ. ν., [[Luk.18.7|Luk.18:7]], [[Rev.4.8|Rev.4:8]], al.; μέσης ν., [[Mat.25.6|Mat.25:6]] dative, νυκτί, in ans. to the question, "when?" (rare in cl.; Hdt., Soph.), ταύτῃ τ. ν., [[Luk.12.20|Luk.12:20]], al.; ἐκείνῃ [[Act.12.6|Act.12:6]] ἐπιούσῃ, [[Act.23.11|Act.23:11]] accusative durat. (Bl., § 34, 8; Kühner3, III, 314b), ν. κ. ἠμέραν, [[Luk.2.37|Luk.2:37]] [[Act.20.31|Act.20:31]]; τ. νύκτας, [[Luk.21.37|Luk.21:37]] διὰ νυκτός (= cl. νυκτός; Bl., § 42, 1; 46, 7), [[Act.5.19; 16.9; 17.10; 23.31|Act.5:19 16:9 17:10 23:31]]; δι᾽ ὅλης ν., [[Luk.5.5|Luk.5:5]] κατὰ μέσον τῆς ν. (Bl., § 47, 6), [[Act.27.27|Act.27:27]] Metaphorical: [[Jhn.9.4|Jhn.9:4]], [[Rom.13.12|Rom.13:12]], [[1Th.5.5|1Th.5:5]]
(AS)

G3508.def:
**Νεφθαλείμ**
(-λίμ, WH in Re, l.with), ὁ
indecl. (Heb. נַפְתָּלִי)
**Naphtali**: [[Mat.4.13, 15|Mat.4:13, 15]]" (LXX) [[Rev.7.6|Rev.7:6]]†
(AS)

G3551.def:
**νόμος**, -ου, ὁ
(νέμω, **to deal out, distribute**), [in LXX chiefly for תּוֹרָה, also for חֻקָּה, etc. ;]
that which is assigned, hence, **usage, custom**, then **law**; in NT (only in Mt, Jo, Ja, and the Lucan and Pauline bks.);
1. **of law in general**: [[Rom.3.27|Rom.3:27]] 5:13b; pl., of divine laws, [[Heb.8.10; 10.16|Heb.8:10 10:16]]; ὁ ν. τ. Χριστοῦ, [[Gal.6.2|Gal.6:2]] (τ.) ἐλευθερίας, [[Jas.1.25; 2.12|Jas.1:25 2:12]]; βασιλικιός (Hort., in l.; Deiss., _LAE_, 267:3), [[Jas.2.8|Jas.2:8]]
2. **Of a force or influence impelling to action**: [[Rom.7.21, 23|Rom.7:21, 23]]a, 25 8:2.
3. **Of the Mosaic law**: [[Mat.5.18|Mat.5:18]], [[Luk.2.27|Luk.2:27]], [[Jhn.1.17|Jhn.1:17]], [[Act.6.13|Act.6:13]], [[Rom.2.15|Rom.2:15]], [[1Co.9.8|1Co.9:8]], [[1Ti.1.8|1Ti.1:8]], [[Heb.7.19|Heb.7:19]] al.; Μωυσέως, [[Luk.2.22|Luk.2:22]], [[Jhn.7.23|Jhn.7:23]], [[Act.15.5|Act.15:5]], al.; κυρίου, [[Luk.2.39|Luk.2:39]] κατὰ τὸν ν., [[Act.22.12|Act.22:12]], [[Heb.7.5; 9.22|Heb.7:5 9:22]].
4. As printed, Abbott-Smith mistakenly numbers this as 3.Anarthrous (Bl, §46, 8; _ICC_ on [[Rom.2.12, 13|Rom.2:12, 13]]), νόμος,
(a) **of law in general**: [[Rom.2.12, 14|Rom.2:12, 14]]b 3:20, 21 4:15, al.;
(b) **of the Mosaic law in its quality as law**: [[Rom.2.14|Rom.2:14]]a 5:20 10:4, [[Gal.2.19|Gal.2:19]], al.; οἱ ἐκ ν., [[Rom.4.14|Rom.4:14]] ὑπὸ νόμον, [[1Co.9.20|1Co.9:20]], [[Gal.4.5|Gal.4:5]]; ν. πράσσειν (πληροῦν), [[Rom.2.25; 13.8|Rom.2:25 13:8]].
5. **Of Christian teaching**: ν. πίστεως, [[Rom.3.27|Rom.3:27]] τ. Χριστοῦ, [[Gal.6.2|Gal.6:2]]
6. By meton., of the books which contain the law;
(a) **of the Pentateuch**: [[Mat.12.5|Mat.12:5]], [[Jhn.1.45|Jhn.1:45]], al.; ὁ ν. καὶ οἱ προφῆται, [[Mat.5.17|Mat.5:17]], [[Luk.16.16|Luk.16:16]], al.; ὁ ν. καὶ προφῆται κ. ψαλμοί, [[Luk.24.44|Luk.24:44]]
(b) **of the OT Scriptures in general **(as Heb. תּוֹרָה): [[Jhn.10.34; 12.34; 15.25|Jhn.10:34 12:34 15:25]], [[1Co.14.21|1Co.14:21]], al.
(AS)

G3538.def:
**νίπτω ** late form of νίζω,
[in LXX chiefly for רָחַץ ;]
**to wash, usually of a part of the body**: with accusative of person(s), [[Jhn.13.8|Jhn.13:8]] τ. πόδας, [[Jhn.13.5-6, 8; 13.12, 14|Jhn.13:5-6, 8 13:12, 14]], [[1Ti.5.10|1Ti.5:10]]; mid., reflexive,
**to wash oneself**: [[Jhn.9.7, 11; 9.15|Jhn.9:7, 11 9:15]]; τ. χεῖρας, [[Mat.15.2|Mat.15:2]], [[Mrk.7.3|Mrk.7:3]]; τ. πόδας, [[Jhn.13.10|Jhn.13:10]] τ. πρόσωπον, [[Mat.6.17|Mat.6:17]] (in cl. Att.. prose, used only in compounds; cf. ἀπο-νίπτω).†
νίζω, see: νίπτω
_SYN._: λούω (which see), πλύνω (AS)

G3567.def:
**νυμφών**, -ῶνος, ὁ
(νύμφη), [in LXX: [[Tob.6.13,16|Tob.6:13,16]]* ;]
the bride-chamber (Heb. חֻפָּה, LXX, παστός, [[Psa.19.5|Psa.19:5]], [[Jol.2.16|Jol.2:16]]): [[Mat.22.10|Mat.22:10]] (WE; γάμος, RV); οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ ν. (cf. cl. νυμφαγωγός, νυμφευτής), the bridegroom's friends who have charge of the nuptial arrangements: [[Mat.9.15|Mat.9:15]], [[Mrk.2.19|Mrk.2:19]], [[Luk.5.34|Luk.5:34]].†
(AS)

G3501.def:
**νέος**, -α, -ον
[in LXX for נַעַר ([[Gen.37.2|Gen.37:2]], Exo_33:11, al.), חָדָשׁ ([[Lev.23.16|Lev.23:16]], [[Num.28.26|Num.28:26]], al.), etc.; compar. -ώτερος for קָטָן, צָעִיר, etc. ;]
1. **young, youthful**: [[Tit.2.4|Tit.2:4]]
2. **new **(prop., in respect of time; see: καινός): οἶνος (cf. οἶ. καινός, [[Mat.26.20|Mat.26:20]]), [[Mat.9.17|Mat.9:17]], [[Mrk.2.22|Mrk.2:22]], [[Luk.5.37-39|Luk.5:37-39]]; φύραμα (figuratively), [[1Co.5.7|1Co.5:7]] διαθήκη (cf. καινὴ δ., [[Heb.9.15|Heb.9:15]]), [[Heb.12.24|Heb.12:24]]; metaphorically, ἄνθρωπος (cf. καινὸς ἀ, [[Eph.2.15|Eph.2:15]]), [[Col.3.10|Col.3:10]].
3. Compar., -ώτερος, -α, -ον, **younger**: [[Luk.15.12-13; 22.26|Luk.15:12-13 22:26]], [[Jhn.21.18|Jhn.21:18]]; pl., οἱ ν., [[Act.5.6|Act.5:6]] (Rackham, in l), [[1Ti.5.11|1Ti.5:11]], [[Tit.2.6|Tit.2:6]]; opposite to πρεσβύτεροι, [[1Ti.5.1|1Ti.5:1]], [[1Pe.5.5|1Pe.5:5]]; αἱ ν., [[1Ti.5.2; 5.14|1Ti.5:2 5:14]].
4. **Νέα Πόλις, Neapolis**: [[Act.16.11|Act.16:11]] (Rec., Νεάπολις, which see)
νεώτερος, see: νέος
_SYN._: καινός, which see (AS)

G3565.def:
**νύμφη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for כַּלָּה ;]
1. cl., **a bride, young wife, young woman**: [[Mat.25.1|Mat.25:1]], WH, mg., [[Jhn.3.29|Jhn.3:29]], [[Rev.18.23; 21.2, 9; 22.17|Rev.18:23 21:2, 9 22:17]].
2. As frequently in LXX ([[Gen.38.11|Gen.38:11]], al., for כַּלָּה;
(a) **bride**;
(b) daughter-in-law) and in M_Gr._ (νύφφη, νύφη), **a daughter-in-law**: [[Mat.10.35|Mat.10:35]], [[Luk.12.53|Luk.12:53]].†
(AS)

G3516.def:
**νήπιος**, -α, -ον
[in LXX chiefly for עוֹלֵל, also for פְּתִי, etc. ;]
**infant; of children and minors**: [[Mat.21.16|Mat.21:16]] (LXX), [[1Co.13.11|1Co.13:11]], [[Gal.4.1|Gal.4:1]] (see Lft., in l). Metaphorical, childish, unskilled, simple ([[Psa.19.8|Psa.19:8]], [[Pro.1.32|Pro.1:32]] al.): [[Mat.11.25|Mat.11:25]], [[Luk.10.21|Luk.10:21]], [[Rom.2.20|Rom.2:20]], [[Gal.4.3|Gal.4:3]], [[Eph.4.14|Eph.4:14]], [[1Th.2.7|1Th.2:7]] (WH, fox ἤπιοι); opposite to τέλειος, [[Heb.5.13|Heb.5:13]] ν. ἐν Χριστῷ, [[1Co.3.1|1Co.3:1]]†
(AS)

G3584.def:
**ξηρός**, -ά, -όν
[in LXX chiefly for יָבֵשׁ, its parts and deriva­tives, also for חָרָבָה, etc. ;]
**dry**: metaphorically (of a sinner), ξύλον ξ., [[Luk.23.31|Luk.23:31]] of members of the body shrunken by disease, **withered**: [[Jhn.5.3|Jhn.5:3]] of the hand, [[Mat.12.10|Mat.12:10]] [[Mrk.3.3|Mrk.3:3]], [[Luk.6.6|Luk.6:6]], 8; of the dry land, ἡ ξηρά (sc. γῆ, cf. [[Gen.1.9-10;|Gen.1:9-10]] [[Jon.1.19|Jon.1:19]], al.): [[Mat.23.15|Mat.23:15]]; γῆ, [[Heb.11.29|Heb.11:29]]†
(AS)

G3558.def:
**νότος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for נֶגֶב, also for דָּרוֹם, תֵּימָן and קָדִים ;]
1. prop., **the south wind**: [[Luk.12.55|Luk.12:55]], [[Act.27.13; 28.13|Act.27:13 28:13]]
2. **South**: [[Luk.13.29|Luk.13:29]], [[Rev.21.13|Rev.21:13]]
3. **the South, as a region **(cf. נֶגֶב): [[Mat.12.42|Mat.12:42]], [[Luk.11.31|Luk.11:31]].†
(AS)

G3583.def:
**ξηραίνω**
(ξηρός), [in LXX chiefly for יָבֵשׁ ;]
to dry up, parch, wither. with accusative, τ. χόρτον, [[Jas.1.11|Jas.1:11]] pass., to become or be dry or withered. of plants, [[Mat.13.6; 21.19-20|Mat.13:6 21:19-20]], [[Mrk.4.6; 11.20-21|Mrk.4:6 11:20-21]], [[Luk.8.6|Luk.8:6]], [[Jhn.15.6|Jhn.15:6]], [[1Pe.1.24|1Pe.1:24]]; of ripened crops, [[Rev.14.15|Rev.14:15]] of liquids, [[Mrk.5.20|Mrk.5:20]], [[Rev.16.12|Rev.16:12]]; of members of the body, to waste away, [[Mrk.3.1|Mrk.3:1]] (cf. [[3Ki.13.4|3Ki.13:4]]) [[Mrk.9.18|Mrk.9:18]].†
(AS)

G3594.def:
**ὁδηγέω**, -ῶ,
(ὁδηγός) [in LXX chiefly for נוּחַ, also for דֶּרֶךְ hi., הָלַךְ hi., etc. ;]
**to lead on one's way, to guide**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.15.14|Mat.15:14]], [[Luk.6.39|Luk.6:39]] id. before ἐπί, [[Rev.7.17|Rev.7:17]] Metaphorical, **to guide, instruct, teach**: [[Act.8.31|Act.8:31]] before εἰς τ. ἀλήθειαν (ἐν τ. ἀ., WH, mg.), [[Jhn.16.13|Jhn.16:13]] (cf. [[Psa.25.5|Psa.25:5]]).†
(AS)

G3539.def:
**νοιεω** νοέω, -ῶ
(νοῦς), [in LXX chiefly for בִּין, also for שָׂכַל hi., etc ;]
1. **to perceive with the mind, understand **(for the phrase νοῶν κ. φρονῶν, in wills, see MM, xvii): absol., [[Mat.16.9|Mat.16:9]], [[Mrk.8.17|Mrk.8:17]]; with accusative, [[Eph.3.4|Eph.3:4]], [[1Ti.1.7|1Ti.1:7]]; with dative instr., τ. καρδίᾳ, [[Jhn.12.40|Jhn.12:40]] pass., [[Rom.1.20|Rom.1:20]] before ὅτι, [[Mat.15.17; 16.11|Mat.15:17 16:11]], [[Mrk.7.18|Mrk.7:18]]; with accusative and inf., [[Heb.11.8|Heb.11:8]]
2. **to think, consider**: absol., [[Mat.24.15|Mat.24:15]], [[Mrk.13.14|Mrk.13:14]], [[Eph.3.20|Eph.3:20]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[2Ti.2.7|2Ti.2:7]]
(cf. -εὐ, κατα-, μετα-, προ-, ὑπο-νοέω).†
(AS)

G3523.def:
**νῆστις**, -ιος, ὁ, ἡ
(νη-, neg. prefix, + ἐσθίω),
in cl., chiefly poët.,
[in LXX: Dan LXX 6:18 (19) (טְוָת)* ;]
**not eating, fasting**: [[Mat.15.32|Mat.15:32]], [[Mrk.8.3|Mrk.8:3]].†
(AS)

G3546.def:
**νόμισμα**, -τος, τό
(νομίζω), [in LXX: [[Est.8.36|Est.8:36]] (דָּת), [[Neh.7.71|Neh.7:71]] R (דַּרְכְּמוֹן), [[1Ma.15.6|1Ma.15:6]] * ;]
1. that which is established by usage, a custom.
2. **The current coin of a state**: [[Mat.22.19|Mat.22:19]]†
(AS)

G3544.def:
**νομικός**, -ή, -όν
(νόμος), [in LXX: [[4Ma.5.4|4Ma.5:4]] * ;]
1. **relating to law**: μάχαι, [[Tit.3.9|Tit.3:9]]
2. **learned in the law**; as subst., ὁ ν. (EV, lawyer): [[Mat.22.35|Mat.22:35]], [[Luk.10.25|Luk.10:25]], [[Tit.3.13|Tit.3:13]]; pl., [[Luk.7.30; 11.45-46, 52; 14.3|Luk.7:30 11:45-46, 52 14:3]] (cf. MM, xvii).†
_SYN._: γραμματεύς, q.v (AS)

G3556.def:
**νοσσίον**, -ου, τό dimin. of νοσσός, which see,
[in LXX: [[Psa.84.3|Psa.84:3]] (אֶפְרֹחַ) * ;]
**a young bird**: [[Mat.23.37|Mat.23:37]]†
(AS)

G3568.def:
**νῦν**, _adv._,
[in LXX chiefly for עַתָּה ;]
1. prop., of time, **now**, i.e. at the present time: as opposite to past, [[Jhn.4.18|Jhn.4:18]], [[Act.7.52|Act.7:52]], [[Rom.13.11|Rom.13:11]], [[2Co.7.9|2Co.7:9]], [[Col.1.24|Col.1:24]], al.; opposite to fut., [[Jhn.12.27|Jhn.12:27]], [[Rom.11.31|Rom.11:31]], al.; with art., ὁ (ἡ, τὸ) and subst., **the present**: [[Rom.3.26|Rom.3:26]], [[Gal.4.25|Gal.4:25]], [[1Ti.6.17|1Ti.6:17]], [[Tit.2.12|Tit.2:12]], al.; απὸ τοῦ ν. (LXX for מֵעַתָּה), [[Luk.1.48|Luk.1:48]], [[Act.18.6|Act.18:6]], al.; ἄχρι τοῦ ν., [[Rom.8.22|Rom.8:22]], [[Php.1.5|Php.1:5]]; ἕως τοῦ ν. (LXX for עַד עַתָּה), [[Mat.24.21|Mat.24:21]], [[Mrk.13.19|Mrk.13:19]]; τὰ ν., **as regards the present**, [[Act.5.38|Act.5:38]] with pret., **just now, but now**, [[Mat.26.65|Mat.26:65]], [[Jhn.11.8; 21.10|Jhn.11:8 21:10]]; with fut., **now, presently**, [[Jhn.12.31|Jhn.12:31]], [[Act.20.22|Act.20:22]]; so with praes., **presently, forthwith**, [[Jhn.12.31; 17.13|Jhn.12:31 17:13]]; καὶ ν., [[Jhn.11.22; 17.5|Jhn.11:22 17:5]], al.; ἀλλὰ ν., [[Luk.22.36|Luk.22:36]] ἔτι ν., [[1Co.3.2|1Co.3:2]] τότε (πότε) . . . ν. (δέ), [[Rom.6.21; 11.30|Rom.6:21 11:30]]; ν. ἤδη, [[1Jn.4.3|1Jn.4:3]] ν. οὖν, [[Act.10.33|Act.10:33]], al.
2. Of logical sequence (often difficult to disting. from the temporal sense; cf. Lft., _Notes_, 113f.), **now, therefore, now, however, as it is**: [[Luk.11.39|Luk.11:39]] καὶ ν., [[Act.3.17|Act.3:17]], [[2Th.2.6|2Th.2:6]], [[1Jn.2.28|1Jn.2:28]]; id. before δεῦρο, [[Act.7.34|Act.7:34]] ν. δέ, [[Jhn.8.40; 9.41; 15.22, 24, 18:36|Jhn.8:40 9:41 15:22, 24, 18:36]], [[1Co.5.11; 7.14; 12.20|1Co.5:11 7:14 12:20]], al. (cf. WM, 579.11).
(AS)

G3573.def:
**νυστάζω**
(cf. νεύω), [in LXX for נוּם, etc ;]
**to nod in sleep, fall asleep**: [[Mat.25.5|Mat.25:5]] Metaphorical, of negligence or delay, ἡ ἀπώλεια αὐτῶν οὐ νυστάζει (cf. [[Psa.121.4|Psa.121:4]], [[Isa.5.27|Isa.5:27]]) : [[2Pe.2.3|2Pe.2:3]].†
(AS)

G3581.def:
**ξένος**, -η, -ον
[in LXX chiefly for נׇכְרִי ;]
(a) **foreign, alien**: δαιμόνια, [[Act.17.18|Act.17:18]] διδαχαί [[Heb.13.9|Heb.13:9]]
(b) with genitive of thing(s), **strange to, estranged from, ignorant of**: [[Eph.2.12|Eph.2:12]]
(with) **strange, unusual**: [[1Pe.4.12|1Pe.4:12]]
As subst., ὁ ξ.,
(a) **a foreigner, stranger**: [[Mat.25.35, 38; 25.43-44; 27.7|Mat.25:35, 38 25:43-44 27:7]], [[Act.17.21|Act.17:21]], [[3Jn.5|3Jn.5]]; ξέίνοι κ. τάροικοι (opposite to συμπολῖται, οίκεῖοι), [[Eph.2.19|Eph.2:19]] ξ. καὶ παρεπίδημοι, [[Heb.11.13|Heb.11:13]]
(b) **one of the parties bound by ties of hospitality**;
α **the guest**;
β the host (= ξενοδόκος, Hom., Ii, xv, 532) : [[Rom.16.23|Rom.16:23]]†
(AS)

G3586.def:
**ξύλον**, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for עֵץ ;]
1. **wood**: [[1Co.3.12|1Co.3:12]], [[Rev.18.12|Rev.18:12]].
2. a piece of wood, hence, anything made of wood, as,
(a) **a cudgel, staff**: pl., [[Mat.26.47, 55|Mat.26:47, 55]], [[Mrk.14.43, 48|Mrk.14:43, 48]], [[Luk.22.52|Luk.22:52]];
(b) stocks, for confining the feet ([[Job.33.11|Job.33:11]], סַד) : [[Act.16.24|Act.16:24]]
(with) a beam to which malefactors were bound (late Gk.), in LXX, of a gibbet ([[Deu.21.22-23|Deu.21:22-23]]), in NT, of the Cross: [[Act.5.30; 10.39; 13.29|Act.5:30 10:39 13:29]], [[Gal.3.13|Gal.3:13]], [[1Pe.2.24|1Pe.2:24]].
3. In late writers (see MM, xvii), a tree ([[Gen.1.29|Gen.1:29]], [[Isa.14.8|Isa.14:8]], al.) : [[Luk.23.31|Luk.23:31]]; ξ. τῆς ζωῆς, [[Rev.2.7; 22.2, 14; 22.19|Rev.2:7 22:2, 14 22:19]].†
(AS)

G3582.def:
**ξέστης**, -ου, ὁ
(a Sicilian corruption of Lat. sextarius), [in Al. : [[Lev.14.10|Lev.14:10]] (לֹג, LXX κοτύλη)* ;]
1. a sextarius (about a pint).
2. **In NT, a pitcher of wood or stone **: [[Mrk.7.4|Mrk.7:4]]†
(AS)

G3590.def:
**ὄγδοος**, -η, -ον
the eighth. [[Luk.1.59|Luk.1:59]], [[Act.7.3|Act.7:3]]" (LXX), [[Rev.17.11; 21.20|Rev.17:11 21:20]]; one of eight, with seven others (usually, in this sense, with αὐτός added, but cf. Plat., Legg., iii, 695 with; Plut., Pelop., 13; [[2Ma.5.27|2Ma.5:27]]): [[2Pe.2.5|2Pe.2:5]].†
(AS)

G3502.def:
**νοσσός** (νεοσσός, Rec., as in cl. Att.. -ττός; Phryn. rejects the dissyl. form), -οῦ, ὁ
(νόος), [in LXX chiefly for בֵּן ;]
**a young bird**: [[Luk.2.24|Luk.2:24]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G3589.def: **eighty **, Lat. _octoginta_, (Thucydides), etc.:—;ionic and doric ὀγδώκοντα, (Iliad by Homer) (ML)

G3521.def:
**νηστεία**, -ας, ἡ
(νηστεύω), [in LXX for צוֹם ;]
**fasting, a fast**;
(a) **of voluntary abstinence from food**: [[Mat.17.21|Mat.17:21]] (WH, R, txt., om.), [[Mrk.9.29|Mrk.9:29]] (WH, txt., R, txt., om.), [[Luk.2.37|Luk.2:37]], [[Act.14.23|Act.14:23]]; of the Day of Atonement, [[Act.27.9|Act.27:9]]
(b) **of involuntary abstinence**: [[2Co.6.5; 11.27|2Co.6:5 11:27]].†
_SYN._: ἀσιτία, q.v (AS)

G3547.def:
**νομο-διδάσκαλος**, -ου, ὁ
**a teacher of the law**: [[Luk.5.17|Luk.5:17]], [[Act.5.34|Act.5:34]], [[1Ti.1.7|1Ti.1:7]] (NT and eccl. only; cf. νομοδείκτης, -διδάκτης, Plut.).†
_SYN._: γραμματεύς, q.v (AS)

G3593.def:
**ὁδεύω**
(ὁδός), [in LXX : [[1Ki.6.12|3Ki.6:12]] A (metaphorically, הָלַךְ), [[Tob.6.5|Tob.6:5]], [[Wis.5.7|Wis.5:7]] (figuratively)* ;]
**to travel, journey**: [[Luk.10.33|Luk.10:33]] (cf.δι-, συν-οδεύω).†
(AS)

G3592.def:
**ὅδε**, ἥδε, τόδε
(the old demonstr. pron., ὁ + the enclitic δε), = Lat. hicce, this (here),
**referring prop, to what is present, can be seen or pointed out**: of a person just named, τῇδε (= ταύτῃ), [[Luk.10.39|Luk.10:39]] neut. pl., τάδε (λέγει), referring to words which follow (so in Att.., and see MM, xvii) : [[Act.21.11|Act.21:11]], [[Rev.2.1, 8; 2.12, 18; 3.1, 7; 3.14|Rev.2:1, 8 2:12, 18 3:1, 7 3:14]]; εἰς τήνδε τ. πόλιν (= Att.. τῇ καὶ τῇ, Plat., Legg., iv, 721 B), such and such a city, [[Jas.4.13|Jas.4:13]]†
(AS)

G3528.def:
**νικἀω**, -ῶ
(νίκη), [in LXX: [[Psa.51.4|Psa.51:4]] (זָכָה), [[Pro.6.25|Pro.6:25]] frequently (חָמַד); in 4Mac ;]
**to conquer, prevail**: absol., of Christ, [[Rev.3.21; 6.2|Rev.3:21 6:2]]; C. inf., [[Rev.5.5|Rev.5:5]] of Christians, [[Rev.2.7, 11; 2.17, 26; 3.5, 12; 3.21; 21.7|Rev.2:7, 11 2:17, 26 3:5, 12 3:21 21:7]]; before ἐκ (RV, come victorious from), [[Rev.15.2|Rev.15:2]] as law-term (cl.), [[Rom.3.4|Rom.3:4]] (LXX); with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.11.22|Luk.11:22]], [[Rev.11.7; 13.7|Rev.11:7 13:7]] ([WH], R, mg., om.); of Christ, [[Jhn.16.33|Jhn.16:33]] (τ. κόσμον), [[Rev.17.14|Rev.17:14]] of Christians, [[1Jn.4.4|1Jn.4:4]] τ. πονηρόν, [[1Jn.2.13-14;|1Jn.2:13-14]] αὐτόν (ref. to ὁ κατήγωρ, [[1Jn.2.10|1Jn.2:10]]), [[Rev.12.11|Rev.12:11]]; with accusative of thing(s), τὸν κόσμον, [[Jhn.16.33|Jhn.16:33]], [[1Jn.5.4-5|1Jn.5:4-5]]; τὸ κακόν, [[Rom.12.21|Rom.12:21]] pass., μὴ νικῶ ὑπὸ τ. κακοῦ, ib. (cf. ὑπερ-νικάω).†
(AS)

G3555.def:
**νοσσιά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
(νοσσός),
late form of cl., νεοσσιά,
[in LXX chiefly for קֵן ;]
1. a nest of birds.
2. **a brood of young birds**: [[Luk.13.34|Luk.13:34]]†
(AS)

G3563.def:
**νοῦς**
(contr. from νόος), ὁ, genitive, dative, νοός, νοΐ (late forms, = cl., νοῦ, νῷ; Bl., § 9, 3), accusative, νοῦν, [in LXX chiefly for לֵב, לֵבָב ;]
1. prop., of the ruling faculty, mind, understanding, reason (see Lft., _Notes_, 88 f.; Vaughan on [[Rom.7.23|Rom.7:23]]): [[Luk.24.45|Luk.24:45]], [[Rom.1.28; 7.23; 12.2; 14.5|Rom.1:28 7:23 12:2 14:5]], [[Eph.4.17, 23|Eph.4:17, 23]] [[Php.4.7|Php.4:7]], [[2Th.2.2|2Th.2:2]], [[1Ti.6.5|1Ti.6:5]], [[2Ti.3.8|2Ti.3:8]], [[Tit.1.15|Tit.1:15]], [[Rev.13.18; 17.9|Rev.13:18 17:9]]; ν. τ. σαρκός (_ICC_, in l), [[Col.2.18|Col.2:18]] opposite to σάρξ, [[Rom.7.25|Rom.7:25]] to πνεῦμα, [[1Co.14.14-15;|1Co.14:14-15]] to γλῶσσα, [[1Co.14.19|1Co.14:19]]
2. By meton., of an act of mind, **a mind, thought, purpose**: [[Rom.11.34|Rom.11:34]] = [[1Co.2.16|1Co.2:16]]" (LXX), [[1Co.1.10|1Co.1:10]]†
νόος, see: νοῦς
_SYN._: see: πνεῦμα (AS)

G3542.def:
**νομή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(νέμω, to pasture), [in LXX chiefly for מִרְעֶה, also for נָוֶה, etc. ;]
1. **a pasture, pasturage**: figuratively, [[Jhn.10.9|Jhn.10:9]]
2. **a grazing, feeding**; metaphorically, of a spreading sore, [[2Ti.2.17|2Ti.2:17]] (Polyb.).†
(AS)

G3506.def:
**νεύω **
[in LXX: [[Pro.4.5; 21.1|Pro.4:5 21:1]] * ;]
**to nod or beckon, as a sign **: with dative of person(s) and inf., [[Jhn.13.24|Jhn.13:24]], [[Act.24.10|Act.24:10]] (cf. δια-, ἐκ-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, κατα-νεύω).†
(AS)

G3557.def:
**νοσφίζω**
(νόσφι, apart, aside), [in LXX: [[Jos.7.1|Jos.7:1]] (לָקַח), [[2Ma.4.32|2Ma.4:32]] * ;]
1. in Hom., as depon., to turn away (from), abandon.
2. After Hom., in act., to set apart, remove. Mid., **to set apart for oneself, peculate, purloin**: absol., [[Tit.2.10|Tit.2:10]] (for ex. in π., see MM, xvii); before ἀπό, [[Act.5.2-3|Act.5:2-3]]†
(AS)

G3579.def:
**ξενίζω**
(ξένος), [in LXX: [[Est.3.13|Est.3:13]], [[Sir.29.25|Sir.29:25]], [[2Ma.9.6|2Ma.9:6]], [[3Ma.7.3|3Ma.7:3]] * ;]
1. **to receive as a guest, entertain**: with accusative of person(s), [[Act.10.23; 28.7|Act.10:23 28:7]], [[Heb.13.2|Heb.13:2]]; pass., [[Act.10.6, 18; 10.32; 21.16|Act.10:6, 18 10:32 21:16]].
2. In late writers (Polyb., al.; 2Mac, l.with), **to surprise, astonish by strangeness**: [[Act.17.20|Act.17:20]] pass., [[1Pe.4.4; 4.12|1Pe.4:4 4:12]].†
(AS)

G3511.def:
**νεω-κόρος**, -ου
**a temple-keeper**; as honorary title given to a city (see _DB_, i, 722 b) : [[Act.19.35|Act.19:35]]†
(AS)

G3587.def:
**ξυράω**, -ῶ
late form of ξυρέω (which see) : [[1Co.11.6|1Co.11:6]] (ξυρᾶσθαι, Rec. and Edd., but see: ξύρω).†
**ξύρω**, rare form of ξυρέω (Veitch, see word), aor. mid., ξύρασθαιι (Bl., § 24, see word; Zorell, see word, etc.) for -ᾶσθαι (Rec., Edd.) : [[1Co.11.6|1Co.11:6]]†
(AS)

G3519.def:
**νησίον**, -ου, τό
(dimin. of νῆσος), = νησίς (Hdt., Thuc., al.)
**a small island**: [[Act.27.16|Act.27:16]]†
(AS)

G3578.def:
**ξενία**, -ας, ἡ
(ξένος), [in LXX: [[Sir.29.27|Sir.29:27]] Bl* ;]
**hospitality, enter­tainment**: Phm 22 (cf. _ICC_, in l, but see infr.). By meton., a place of entertainment, **a lodging-place**: [[Act.28.23|Act.28:23]], and so perh. Phm 22 (Lft., in l, Phi., p. 9; but see supr., and cf. MM, xvii).†
(AS)

G3500.def:
**νέκρωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(νεκρόω),
1. a putting to death.
2. **a state of death, death**: [[Rom.4.19|Rom.4:19]], [[2Co.4.10|2Co.4:10]] (see Deiss., _LAE_, 94).†
(AS)

G3577.def:
**νῶτος**, -ου, ὁ
in Att.. most frequently τὸ νῶτον, and in pl. always τὰ νῶτα, [in LXX, ὁ ν., pl., οἱ νῶτοι and τὰ νῶτα, chiefly for כָּתֵף, also for עֹרֶף, מֹתֶן ;]
**/the back**: [[Rom.11.10|Rom.11:10]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G3517.def: **Nereus **, a sea-god, son of Πόντος **(the sea) **, father of the Nereids, (Hesiod) (ML)

G3559.def:
**νουθεσία**, -ας ἡ
(νουθετέω),
= cl. νουθέτησις
[in LXX: [[Wis.6.6|Wis.6:6]] * ;]
**admonition**: [[1Co.10.11|1Co.10:11]], [[Eph.6.4|Eph.6:4]], [[Tit.3.10|Tit.3:10]] (Aristoph., Diod., al.).†
(AS)

G3513.def:
**νή **
_particle_ of affirmation employed in oaths, [in LXX: see τ. ὑγίειαν, [[Gen.42.15-16|Gen.42:15-16]] (חַי) * ;]
**by**: with accusative, [[1Co.15.31|1Co.15:31]]†
(AS)

G3574.def:
**νυχθήμερος**, -α, -ον
(νύξ, ἡμέρα, see B1., § 28, 4),
**lasting a night and a day**; as subst., (τὸ) ν., **a night and a day**: [[2Co.11.25|2Co.11:25]] (pl., Or. Sib., 8, 203).†
(AS)

G3561.def:
**νεομηνία** (Att.. contr., νουμ-, Rec.), -ας, ἡ
(νέος, μήν), [in LXX chiefly for חֹדֶשׁ ;]
**new moon**: of the Jewish festival, [[Col.2.16|Col.2:16]]†
(AS)

G3564.def:
**Νυμφᾶς**, -ᾶ, ὁ (WH, R, mg., Νύμφα, which see),
**Nymphas**: [[Col.4.15|Col.4:15]], R, txt. (cf. _ICC_, Lft., in l).†
**Νύμφα** (Rec., R, txt., Νυμφᾶς, which see), -ης, ἡ, **Nympha **(see M, _Pr._, 48): [[Col.4.15|Col.4:15]], WH, R, mg.†
(AS)

G3525.def:
**νήφω **
**to be sober, abstain from wine**; metaphorically, of moral alertness, to be sober, **calm, circumspect**: [[1Th.5.6; 5.8|1Th.5:6 5:8]], [[2Ti.4.5|2Ti.4:5]] (see Ellic., in l), [[1Pe.1.13; 4.7; 5.8|1Pe.1:13 4:7 5:8]] (cf. ἐκ-, ἐκ-νήφω, and see MM, xvii).†
_SYN._: ἀγρυπνέω, γρηγορέω (AS)

G3524.def:
**νηφάλιος** (-λεος, Rec., in 1Ti, ll. with), -ον (in cl., -α, -ον),
(νήφω),
1. in cl., of drink, not mixed with wine.
2. In later writers (Plut., al.), of persons, **sober, temperate**: [[1Ti.3.2; 3.11|1Ti.3:2 3:11]], [[Tit.2.2|Tit.2:2]].†
(AS)

G3504.def:
**νεό-φυτος**, -ον
(νέος, φύω) [in LXX: [[Job.14.9|Job.14:9]], [[Psa.144.12|Psa.144:12]], [[Isa.5.7|Isa.5:7]] (נֶטַע), [[Psa.128.3|Psa.128:3]] (שְׁתִל)* ;]
newly planted (LXX). Metaphorical, as subst., ὁ ν., **a new convert, neophyte, novice**: [[1Ti.3.6|1Ti.3:6]]†
(AS)

G3580.def:
**ξενοδοχέω ** late Gk. for -κέω
(ξένος, δέχομαι),
**to entertain strangers**: [[1Ti.5.10|1Ti.5:10]]†
(AS)

G3552.def:
**νοσέω**, -ῶ
(νόσος), [in LXX (metaphorically): [[Wis.17.8|Wis.17:8]] * ;]
**to be sick**: metaphorically, of mental ailment, before περί, [[1Ti.6.4|1Ti.6:4]] (cf. Plat., Mor., 546 d).†
(AS)

G3585.def:
**ξύλινος**, -η, -ον
(ξύλον) [in LXX chiefly for עֵץ ;]
**wooden**: [[2Ti.2.20|2Ti.2:20]], [[Heb.9.20|Heb.9:20]] (cf. Ep. [[Jer.4.1-31|Jer.4:1-31]] ff).†
(AS)

G3512.def:
**νεωτερικός**, -ή, -όν
(νεώτερος), [in LXX: [[3Ma.4.8|3Ma.4:8]] * ;]
= νεανικός,
youthful, esp. of qualities: ἐπιθυμίαι, [[2Ti.2.22|2Ti.2:22]] (Polyb.).†
(AS)

G3533.def:
**Νικόπολις**, -εως, ἡ
Nicopolis, prob. the city of that name in Epirus (CGT, in l): [[Tit.3.12|Tit.3:12]]†
(AS)

G3576.def:
**νωθρός**, -ά, -όν
[in LXX: [[Pro.22.29|Pro.22:29]] (חָשֹׁךְ), [[Sir.4.29; 11.12|Sir.4:29 11:12]] * ;]
**sluggish, slothful**: [[Heb.5.11; 6.12|Heb.5:11 6:12]] (for similar usage in π., see MM, xvii).
_SYN._: ἀργός (which see), βραδύς (AS)

G3549.def:
**νομοθετέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for יָרָה hi. ;]
1. intrans., to make laws; pass., **to be furnished with laws**: [[Heb.7.11|Heb.7:11]]
2. Trans., **to ordain by law, enact**: pass., [[Heb.8.6|Heb.8:6]]†
(AS)

G3509.def:
**νέφος**, -ους, τό
[in LXX for עָב, שַׁחַק, עָנַן ;]
**a mass of clouds, a cloud **(cf. νεφέλη); metaphorically as in Hom., Hdt., al.), of a dense throng: [[Heb.12.1|Heb.12:1]]†
(AS)

G3591.def:
**ὄγκος**, -ου, ὁ
**bulk, mass**; metaphorically, **an encumbrance**: [[Heb.12.1|Heb.12:1]]†
_SYN._: βάρος, a weight; φορτίον, a burden, that which is borne (AS)

G3541.def:
**νόθος**, -η, -ον
[in LXX: [[Wis.4.3|Wis.4:3]] * ;]
a bastard, base born, i.e. born of a slave or concubine: [[Heb.12.8|Heb.12:8]]†
(AS)

G3510.def:
**νεφρός**, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX for כִּלְיָה, [[Exo.29.13|Exo.29:13]], al.; metaphorically, [[Psa.7.9; 16.7; 26.2|Psa.7:9 16:7 26:2]], [[Wis.1.6|Wis.1:6]], al. ;]
**a kidney**; pl., the kidneys, reins; metaphorically, of the will and affections: ν. καί καρδίαι (thoughts), [[Rev.2.23|Rev.2:23]]†
(AS)
